about.title: About Me & Journey
about.subtitle: From hardware curiosity to developing production systems
about.profileP1: I am a Full Stack & Mobile Developer based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, pursuing a Software Engineering degree at Uninter, with graduation expected in 2027. I have studied programming since late 2023 and worked professionally since April 2025.
about.profileP2: My stack includes Java and Spring Boot, C# and .NET, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, and React Native. I work with APIs, relational databases, caching, and messaging, applying automated tests, log analysis, and query optimization. I also develop my knowledge of AWS, networking, scalability, and service reliability.
about.journeyP1: My first programming experiences were with Python through Professor Gustavo Guanabara’s courses. I have been studying programming consistently since late 2023.
about.journeyP2: Influenced by friends, I dove deep into computer hardware and built my own PC from scratch (a Xeon E5-2650v2 paired with a GTX 1660Ti). That low-level foundation sparked my lifelong passion for Software Engineering and building scalable, well-architected systems.

capys.summary: Developing, evolving, and maintaining CRM systems, web portals, internal applications, and mobile apps for real estate enterprises.
achievements: Developed and maintained CRM systems, web portals, and services for the real estate sector. Integrated ERP systems such as UAU, TOTVS, Informakon, and Sienge, communication platforms (Meta and Twilio), and electronic signature services via APIs.
Develop, maintain, and publish Android and iOS apps on Google Play and the App Store.
Diagnose and resolve critical failures in services supporting financial operations, including payments, by analyzing logs.
Reduced database query and routine execution time from about 2 minutes to 15–20 seconds by analyzing execution plans and tuning joins, filters, and indexes.
Collaborate with L1 and L2 support to communicate findings, validate fixes, and prioritize incidents based on customer impact.

uninter.summary: Academic degree focused on software architecture, requirements engineering, data structures, database design, software quality, and automated testing.
achievements: In-depth application of Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, SOLID, and Design Patterns to real-world systems.
Practical study of algorithm complexity (Big O Notation), relational database normalization (BCNF), and distributed systems.

achievements: Hardware diagnostics, OS tuning, and definitive transition into professional software engineering.

mangaReader.title: Toonlira (Manga Reader)
mangaReader.subtitle: Polyglot Web & Mobile Manga Reading Platform
mangaReader.architecture: Clean Architecture (Backend) + Feature-Sliced Design (Web & Mobile) + Polyglot Persistence
mangaReader.description: Web and mobile manga reading platform with a catalog, library and community. Mobile includes an immersive reader, image import and offline resume; the authenticated platform and remote translation remain in development.
features: Java + Spring Boot API with three jobs: review aggregation, data reconciliation and trending rankings.
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Neo4j and Redis, with asynchronous RabbitMQ events and layered architecture.
React + TypeScript web and React Native + Expo mobile; refresh-token rotation and PT/EN/ES internationalization.

Mobile reader with vertical, paginated and dual-page modes, private projects and progress stored in SQLite. Translation gateway under construction; tests with JUnit, Testcontainers, Vitest, Testing Library and MSW.

dbmind.title: DBMind
dbmind.subtitle: AI-Powered Database Auditor
dbmind.architecture: Clean Architecture + Spec-Driven Development (SDD) + FSD + TDD
dbmind.description: Intelligent auditing platform for relational databases (PostgreSQL and SQL Server), featuring automated execution plan analysis, index bottleneck detection, and AI-assisted SQL optimization recommendations.
features: Java and Spring Boot engine inspecting metadata, execution plans, and table statistics across PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Asynchronous heavy audit processing via RabbitMQ and diagnostic caching with Redis.
Modular analytical frontend built with Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) delivering actionable SQL tuning reports.

debugInsight.title: DebugInsight
debugInsight.subtitle: Advanced Chrome & Firefox DevTools Extension
debugInsight.architecture: Manifest V3 Multi-Entry + Correlation Engine + Zustand
debugInsight.description: Browser DevTools extension for deep frontend inspection: smart console capture, network analysis (4xx/5xx, slow/duplicate routes), localStorage tree inspector, Web Vitals/TTFB severity metrics, and automated error correlation.
features: Automated correlation engine linking console logs, network failures (fetch/XHR), and DOM/memory mutations in real time.
Automatic performance severity classification (TTFB, DNS, DOMContentLoaded) and top-10 heaviest resource charts.
Full diagnostic report export in JSON and CSV formats, with built-in i18n (EN, ES, PT-BR).

Full lifecycle development and store publication of Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store) apps with offline SQLite sync.
Distributed integrations via REST APIs, Webhooks, Redis caching, and automated Microsoft CI/CD pipelines.
